research_question: Does literal execution of member-proposed local conditions improve final choice beyond the same structured contributions, on fresh compatible tasks?
scope: representation-assisted component screening; not full CoReTA, unrestricted dialogue, broad generalization or automatic schema discovery
stop_rule: First technical failure stops entire batch; preserve raw response, consumed budget and all uncompleted roster rows. No automatic resume, replacement or expansion.
control: Identical task, recipient, shared generated contributions, field vocabulary and common prompt within each pair. Executed arm alone receives literal report; actual input budget differs and must be reported. Repeat1 A1 text then executed; repeat2 A2 executed then text.
prompt_policy: No semantic prompt correction relative to previous transfer pilot; retain source-skepticism risk in both arms. Only task vocabulary and batch scheduling expanded.
primary_metrics: official option accuracy per arm over 20 outputs
per-task result distribution over two repeats, task-averaged difference
secondary_metrics: requirement coverage and empty condition counts
actual application of decisive colleague contribution
technical failures and all token costs with extraction shared
analysis_policy: 20 repetitions are clustered within 10 tasks, not 20 independent tasks. Report exact counts; no paper-level stable-superiority claim. Review all final reasons and decisive encoding chains, not just winning cases. Native irrelevant/redundant source remains.

decisions.net_positive_across_multiple_tasks: Promising screening signal only; next compare to similar-budget ordinary checklist/summary, before larger claims.
decisions.mostly_ties: Review baseline ceiling and whether execution changes decisions; no automatic harder-task search.
decisions.encoding_errors_dominate: Prioritize source-to-representation issue, not added coordination.
decisions.net_negative: Pause expansion and inspect harmful exclusions or report influence.
decisions.technical_stop: Incomplete pilot only; diagnose separately and review new batch before any paid rerun.

selection_and_holdout: First compatible ascending IDs10..27 using content-only manual exclusions; selected tasks move from evaluation pool to development, not final held-out evidence.

estimated_usage_from_previous_batch.basis: 5x prior 24-call transfer batch; approximate, not cap or price quote

authorization: Not yet authorized for this new 120-call batch; local preparation only.
